Title: NVIDIA Invests in Korean AI Startups, Including Point2Tech
Description: At its AI startup forum in Seoul, NVIDIA said it will invest in Korea's Point2Tech and plans to add Motif, Realworld and Upstage; Upstage now counts Amazon, AMD and NVIDIA as backers.

Title: Musk: Tesla May Rent Out Optimus Rather Than Sell It
Description: Musk said Tesla will likely rent its humanoid robots to customers rather than sell them; early Optimus production has begun at the Fremont plant, with external deliveries expected around late 2027.

Title: NVIDIA Partners with SK Telecom to Advance Sovereign AI Infrastructure
Description: NVIDIA, Rebellions and SK Telecom announced a partnership to build sovereign AI infrastructure based on NVIDIA's NVLink Fusion.

Title: SpaceX Plans Starship Test Launch on November 13
Description: SpaceX said it plans to launch Starship as early as Nov 13, subject to regulatory approval; the 75-minute window opens at 4:45 pm Central, and the flight will for the first time attempt to return and catch both the ship and Super Heavy booster.

Title: Strategy Discloses $4.79B Reserve, Raised About $431.8M From Bitcoin Sales in 2026
Description: Strategy disclosed a $4.79 billion designated dollar reserve and $132.7 million in cash as of Nov 1; through October 2026 it raised about $431.8 million by selling bitcoin to fund dividends and buybacks.

Title: Google Quietly Bought Qualcomm Stake as Chipmaker Targets Data Centers and $15B+ Annual Revenue
Description: Alphabet held about 2.977 million Qualcomm shares worth roughly $548 million at end-Q3, a new position; Qualcomm targets $5 billion in data-center revenue by FY2027 and over $15 billion by FY2029.

Title: Sudden Plunge! AI Giant Ends Partnership
Description: Microsoft is phasing out AI compute rented from Oracle after declining to renew, as the hardware runs prior-generation NVIDIA chips; Oracle shares fell about 3% intraday before a deep V-shaped recovery.

Title: Coinbase CEO Backs Tokenizing the Company's Stock to Reach New Shareholders
Description: Coinbase CEO Brian Armstrong said he supports tokenizing the company's stock to let more people own it, arguing it is unwise to shut out a potential new shareholder base.

Title: Democrats Plan to Investigate Apple, Meta and Musk as Trump's Silicon Valley Allies Face Reckoning
Description: After winning both chambers, Democrats are setting investigative priorities, with Apple flagged over an ICE-tracking app and Meta over local data-center deals; SpaceX shares held firm.

Title: Amazon Launches Text-Based Shopping Feature
Description: Amazon launched a text-based shopping feature via Alexa that helps users search and compare products, track deals and prices, and complete purchases; it is initially open to a small group of invited US users.
